prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite atlas for VOICES, a cozy top-down pixel-art RPG. Consistent three-quarter top-down front view matching RPG Maker interior furnishings. Crisp low-resolution pixel clusters, dark warm 1-2 pixel outlines and restrained 3-4 tone shading. Materials must look like PROFESSIONAL INDUSTRIAL STAINLESS STEEL: brushed silver gray, pale blue-gray highlights, charcoal legs and fittings, small muted teal accents. No wooden cabinets, no brass or gold appliances, no domestic vintage furniture, no photorealistic rendering, no smooth gradients, no blur. Real transparent alpha background, no floor slab, no people, no writing, no brands, no borders. Each whole object completely isolated within its equal square cell, minimum 20px transparent gutters. All legs, taps, handles and utensils must be complete and not touch neighbouring cells. Exactly 4 columns x 4 rows, sixteen objects. Row 1: (1) stainless central food preparation island with lower open steel shelf, cutting board and a few vegetables; (2) professional six-burner stainless gas range with oven below and a black stockpot; (3) wide commercial two-basin stainless washing sink, tall pre-rinse spray hose and drainboard, open steel legs; (4) open industrial wire pantry shelving with food-safe jars of beans, maize, rice, flour sacks and covered bins. Row 2: (1) commercial upright two-door stainless refrigerator; (2) stainless wall rail holding ladles, whisks, spatulas and a strainer; (3) stainless pastry workbench with mixing bowl, flour container and rolling pin; (4) wheeled stainless spice trolley with small covered jars and herbs. Row 3: (1) large stainless extraction hood and short ventilation duct; (2) stainless dish drying counter with plates, glasses and metal racks; (3) two lidded stainless pedal bins, one with a small green recycling symbol but no text; (4) herbs in small steel food-safe planters on a stainless sill. Row 4: (1) commercial double stainless swing doors with small round porthole windows; (2) square white metal industrial kitchen window with subtle blue sky panes; (3) red wall fire extinguisher and compact first-aid box together in a bracket; (4) stainless serving trolley with covered rectangular gastronorm trays and clean plate stacks.
